items.title: Edgar Wright Says New AI Remaster of Cult TV Comedy 'Spaced' Is a 'Bummer': 'Not Authorized by Anyone Involved in Making the Show'
items.headline: Edgar Wright Says New AI Remaster of Cult TV Comedy 'Spaced' Is a 'Bummer': 'Not Authorized by Anyone Involved in Making the Show'
items.excerpt: A new AI-upscaled 4K Blu-ray release of the cult British comedy Spaced has sparked backlash, with director Edgar Wright saying the AI remaster was not authorized by anyone involved in making the show.
items.rationale: A new event: a commercial AI-upscaled 4K release that the director publicly says nobody who made the show approved. It is the clearest case yet of AI restoration done without creator consent.

items.title: 영화 각본도 챗GPT가 쓴다…일본, 전편 생성형 AI 장편영화 2027년 공개
items.headline: 영화 각본도 챗GPT가 쓴다…일본, 전편 생성형 AI 장편영화 2027년 공개
items.excerpt: Japanese producers (Oxons, Tender Pro) announced 'Jikū Yūkaku Labyrinth', a feature made entirely with generative AI -- ChatGPT-written script, AI-recreated likenesses of three real actors, Suno theme song -- slated for 2027.
items.rationale: A new production announcement: a fully generative feature with a ChatGPT-written script, licensed AI likenesses of real actors and a Suno theme. It lays out an end-to-end AI pipeline.

items.title: Idris Elba, Google launch free AI filmmaking programme in five African countries
items.headline: Idris Elba, Google launch free AI filmmaking programme in five African countries
items.excerpt: Akuna Learning, from Idris Elba's Akuna Group, and Google opened applications for a free AI filmmaking programme with production funding for emerging creators in five African countries (applications to Nov 15).
items.rationale: Actionable: a free AI filmmaking programme with production funding is taking applications now, until Nov 15. It is a new launch, not commentary.

items.title: iQIYI opens AI film studio in Shanghai, starts first production
items.headline: iQIYI opens AI film studio in Shanghai, starts first production
items.excerpt: iQIYI opened an AI film studio at its Shanghai Creative Center and began production of its first project there, the internet feature film 'Cop in Trouble' (announced Oct 28).
items.rationale: A major streamer opens a dedicated AI film stage and starts shooting its first feature there. It is production infrastructure, not a funding round.

items.title: 대전 2인 제작진의 AI 영화, 뉴욕 영화제 수상…인간이 연출하고 AI가 영상 구현
items.headline: 대전 2인 제작진의 AI 영화, 뉴욕 영화제 수상…인간이 연출하고 AI가 영상 구현
items.excerpt: Daejeon two-person Studio UNMU's 11-minute AI sci-fi short 'LAST CALL' won an Honorable Mention for Best AI-Generated or Assisted Film at New York's 30th Urbanworld Film Festival; humans scripted, directed, edited and mixed while generative AI rendered the imagery.
items.rationale: A new festival honour for a two-person Korean team, with a clear split of the work: humans scripted, directed, edited and mixed, and AI rendered the images. A practical model for small crews.
